text:
samir: Hey all 

Sparrowhawk POC hit a performance hiccup during the live demo. Small prompts returning first token in ~1.0-1.5s and then some 429s after ~3 minutes of demo traffic. Can eng/ops swarm? :eyes:

elaine: Customer on hosted sandbox or dedicated eval? Also theyre going to ask about pricing/commit.

samir: Hosted sandbox in us-west-2. Demo script does short calls (~10 rps bursts). Prefill=true in script.

ryan: Can you paste the curl and response payload/header? Need model variant too.

samir: Here's the exact curl we used:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize: This is a test\n","max_tokens":64,"prefill":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?model=redwood-13b-v2
```
They saw TTFT ~1.2s then steady streaming. After ~3m we started getting repeated 429s: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":15}

maria: Quick checks: are they using any VPC egress or special network setup? And do they enable prefill on purpose?

samir: No VPC, hosted sandbox. They intentionally set prefill=true to show faster streaming in the demo.

ryan: Likely a combo: (1) prefill + default batch_window causing batching tail, (2) burst fills queue -> tenant rate limits produce 429s. Suggestions:
- Toggle prefill=false for interactive demo A/B.
- Reduce batch_window_ms from default 20 to 8 for tiny prompts.
- Ops can temporarily bump tenant rate_limit to 30rps.
- Enable prefix KV caching if prompts repeat.
- If persistent, route to spare dedicated pool.

elaine: Sales: if the fix is dedicated lanes, what minimum commit do we propose? Need a ballpark to give customer.

maria: Ops will bump tenant rps and capture metrics. Deploy-bot: take a serving snapshot now.

deploy-bot: Snapshot taken: pool=us-west-2-sandbox, ts=3214567902. Metrics: avg_ttft=1.18s, p95_ttft=1.34s, queue_depth=48, inflight_batches=6, kv_cache_hit=12%, top_error=429_capacity_exceeded.

ryan: KV hit ~12% low. If demo repeats same system prompt, enabling prefill/KV helps for throughput but prefill combined with larger batch windows increases TTFT for tiny prompts. Queue depth 48 suggests burst smoothing needed.

samir: Did a quick local A/B: switched prefill=false and set batch_window_ms=8. Re-ran demo. New metrics: avg_ttft=0.42s, p95=0.55s, and no 429s in first 90s. Looks much better.

elaine: So recommended immediate guidance for demos: prefill=false + tighten batch window. For production demos we can propose KV prefill and reserved lane.

maria: Filed OPS-4821: temporary tenant rps increase and watch queues. Added routing fallback to smaller model when queue_depth>60 to avoid errors.

ryan: Action items for eng/product: implement adaptive batch window that detects short prompt patterns and reduces delay. I'll open a short RFC/pr.

samir: Customer asked pricing for a small dedicated pool. Elaine, will you propose a minimal commit?

elaine: Draft to share: recommend ~0.5k GPU-hours/month as a minimal reserved lane for predictable interactive demos; include burst credits option. Will send formal quote.

ryan: Root cause summary: prefill + large batch window increased per-request latency and, under burst, queue filled triggering tenant throttles and 429s. Workarounds: prefill toggle, lower batch window, bump tenant rate limit, or reserve dedicated pool.

samir: Thanks everyone. I'll send the postmortem to the customer and include OPS-4821. Closing unless more issues crop up. :thumbsup:
